meta_description: Architecture and design of Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — onboard recognition and assistive audio for visually challenged users.

blocks.x: How Driisti is built: onboard AI, immediate audio guidance and privacy-first data handling.

Lightweight glasses carry the camera and processing unit; recognition runs on device where possible, with cloud assistance for heavier tasks. Audio output is immediate and localized to the user. Care-circle features let family members stay connected where the user opts in.

items: Scene descriptions without network dependence for core tasks
Guidance delivered while it is still useful
Family connection only with the user's consent
Camera data processed for the user, not stored for others
